defs.def: aware of sth, especially a problem or danger 意识到；注意到
to warn sb about a dangerous or urgent situation 向 … 报警；使警觉；使警惕；使戒备
to make sb aware of sth 使意识到；使认识到
a situation in which people are watching for danger and ready to deal with it 警戒；戒备；警惕
